techdella.help: Set postId to a published case_study or studio_work post. The inline item {title, client, industry, country, timeframe, excerpt, metrics:[{num,label}], url, status (Live/Concept), disciplines[], image, imageAlt, visual (table|phones|chat|video)} is used only when no post is set or found. Inline proof must come from §2.4.
